title: Ernesto picks up checks; Ray Block
summary: Ernesto fetched checks and deposited them.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: Poor Ernesto, he finally -- one of the famous stories about Ernesto is, you know, he went and picked up all the musicians' checks, too.
NBC, CBS, he'd just get all the checks and whatever recording session you were on, he'd bring you your check.
Yeah. Well, some guys would really be literally so busy they didn't have time.
I used to come into town, 8:00 in the morning, get home at midnight. But I always took my weekends off to be with the children. I never worked on Saturday or Sunday.

And one time Ernesto -- well, 35 years he used to pick up Ray Block's checks. 35 years he picked them up, and he took Ray's check to the bank and deposited it. And one day something happened and Ernesto wasn't around, and Ray Block took his own check over to the bank and tried to deposit it and they arrested Ray Block.
